compactRecord.rs: Japan's largest brackish lagoon — sunsets across an oyster-farming lake the size of a sea; quietest big lake in Hokkaidō.
compactRecord.td: Japan's third-largest lake (150 km²) — a 25 km coastal lagoon separated from the Sea of Okhotsk by a sandbar. Famed for scallop & oyster farming and sunsets from the three Saroma view-hills. Ramsar wetland.
